parameters.jsCode:
const context = $input.first().json;

const queue = context.asset_creation_queue;

if (!Array.isArray(queue) || queue.length === 0) {
  throw new Error(
    "No asset creation jobs were supplied to AGENT-007."
  );
}

return queue.map((job, index) => ({
  json: {
    asset_creation_batch_id:
      context.asset_creation_batch_id,

    production_readiness_manifest_id:
      context.production_readiness_manifest_id,

    asset_resolution_run_id:
      context.asset_resolution_run_id,

    production_plan_run_id:
      context.production_plan_run_id,

    episode_script_id:
      context.episode_script_id,

    episode_code:
      context.episode_code,

    script_version:
      context.script_version,

    title_working:
      context.title_working,

    job_index:
      index + 1,

    total_job_count:
      queue.length,

    requirement_key:
      job.requirement_key ?? null,

    requirement_type:
      job.requirement_type ?? null,

    source_asset_id:
      job.source_asset_id ?? null,

    source_label:
      job.source_label ?? null,

    affected_shots:
      Array.isArray(job.affected_shots)
        ? job.affected_shots
        : [],

    creation_brief:
      job.creation_brief ?? {},

    next_action:
      job.next_action ?? null,

    agent_version:
      context.agent_version,

    prompt_version:
      context.prompt_version,

    human_approval_required:
      true
  }
}));
